content: Name Buf Req_ Return Type Kind Enumeration Range BUFREQ_ OK 0x00 Buffer request accomplished successful. This status shall have the value 0. BUFREQ_ E_ NOT_ OK 0x01 Buffer request not successful. Buffer cannot be accessed. This status shall have the value 1. BUFREQ_ E_ BUSY 0x02 Temporarily no buffer available. It's up the requester to retry request for a certain time. This status shall have the value 2. BUFREQ_ E_ OVFL 0x03 No Buffer of the required length can be provided. This status shall have the value 3. Description Variables of this type shall be used to store the result of a buffer request. Available via Com Stack_ Types.h
